# Run a nested script through the maintained Go API.
exec go mod init example.com/scriptfixture
exec go mod edit -require=github.com/tmc/mcp@v0.0.0 -replace=github.com/tmc/mcp=$MCP_REPO_ROOT
exec env GOWORK=off go test -mod=mod -v .
stdout 'dummy.txt'
stdout 'PASS'

-- script_test.go --
package scriptfixture

import (
    "testing"

    "github.com/tmc/mcp/mcpscripttest"
)

func TestScripts(t *testing.T) {
    mcpscripttest.Test(t, "testdata/dummy.txt")
}

-- testdata/dummy.txt --
exec echo 'Hello from test'
stdout 'Hello from test'
